cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last over the line, first at noticing the route. I taught you to look around when we ran; how many wildflowers did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You read the entry form this time. Good. Now name three things you passed. I can give you six before we reach the gate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I noticed the finish line. That's what counted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One thing against my six. Let's score memory instead; repeat my six after I say them, the way we practised on training runs. Ready to lose this round?
